documents.title: Small habits, lasting change
documents.channel: Platypus Studio · 自编演示素材

sentences.english: Small habits can create remarkable changes in our everyday lives.
sentences.chinese: 小小的习惯可以给我们的日常生活带来显著的变化。

sentences.english: You don't need a perfect plan to begin; you need a practical first step.
sentences.chinese: 开始不需要一个完美的计划，而需要务实的第一步。

sentences.english: A resilient learner stays curious, even when progress feels slow.
sentences.chinese: 一个有韧性的学习者，即使感觉进步缓慢，也会保持好奇心。

sentences.english: Consistency matters more than intensity, because small actions build confidence.
sentences.chinese: 坚持比强度更重要，因为小小的行动能够建立信心。

sentences.english: Try writing a vivid example whenever you discover an unfamiliar word.
sentences.chinese: 每当你遇到一个不熟悉的单词，试着写下一个生动的例子。

sentences.english: Over time, these habits become a sustainable part of your learning journey.
sentences.chinese: 随着时间推移，这些习惯会成为你学习旅程中可以持续的一部分。

documents.title: Stay curious, keep learning
documents.channel: Platypus Studio · 自编演示素材

sentences.english: Curiosity helps us notice extraordinary details in ordinary places.
sentences.chinese: 好奇心帮助我们在平凡的地方发现不平凡的细节。

sentences.english: Ask a thoughtful question instead of accepting the first explanation.
sentences.chinese: 提出一个经过思考的问题，而不是直接接受第一个解释。

sentences.english: A resilient mind can adapt when new evidence challenges an old belief.
sentences.chinese: 当新证据挑战旧观念时，有韧性的头脑能够做出调整。

sentences.english: You can turn a brief conversation into a meaningful learning experience.
sentences.chinese: 你可以把一次简短的交谈变成一次有意义的学习经历。
